steps.title: What is SPIN Serial Basics?
steps.markdown:
This tutorial walks you through setting up a live serial connection to an OwnTech SPIN board, flashing the **duty cycle setting** firmware, and recording data to CSV.

You will need:
- An OwnTech SPIN board connected via USB
- A few minutes to work through each step

**What you will learn:**
- How to add a serial port datasource
- How to flash firmware from inside the dashboard
- How to send commands to the board
- How to record live data to a CSV file

steps.title: Connect the SPIN board
steps.markdown:
Plug in your SPIN board via USB.

1. Open the **Datasources** side panel and click **Add datasource**.
2. Select **Serial Port** from the picker.
3. In the settings dialog, give it a name (e.g. `SPIN`), select your board's COM port from the **Port** dropdown, and click **OK**.

The datasource will appear in the panel once connected.

steps.title: Create a pane
steps.markdown:
Every widget lives inside a **pane**.

Click the **Add pane** button in the top bar.

steps.title: Add the firmware flasher
steps.markdown:
Click the **Add widget** icon on the pane, then select **Serial Firmware Flasher** from the widget picker.

The tutorial firmware will be pre-loaded for you.

steps.title: Flash the firmware
steps.markdown:
The firmware file is pre-loaded in the flasher widget.

1. Make sure your SPIN board's port is selected in the **Serial Port** dropdown.
2. Click **Start Flash** and wait for it to finish.

The board will reboot automatically when the flash is complete.

steps.title: Set up command buttons
steps.markdown:
Add a **Serial Commands Sender** widget to the pane.

In its settings dialog:
1. Set **Datasource** to your serial datasource.
2. Add a button: label `Duty UP`, command `u`.
3. Add a second button: label `Duty DOWN`, command `d`.
4. Click **OK**.

You can now send commands to the running firmware by clicking the buttons.

steps.title: Add the CSV recorder
steps.markdown:
Add a **Serial CSV Recorder** widget to the pane.

You can leave the default file path (`record.csv`) or change it to a location of your choice.

Click **OK** to add it.

steps.title: Start recording
steps.markdown:
In the CSV Recorder widget, click **Start Record**.

The button will change to **Stop Record** to indicate that data is being saved. Watch the board produce live measurements.

steps.title: Tutorial complete
steps.markdown:
Your SPIN board is live, flashed, and recording data.

**What you learned:**
- Adding a serial port datasource and connecting to the SPIN board
- Flashing firmware from inside the dashboard
- Sending duty cycle commands to the board
- Recording live serial data to CSV

Close this panel with **Done** and explore the dashboard further.
